title: Credential Compromise Investigation
story: The SOC detected repeated authentication failures against the Black Falcon Bank administration server. Shortly afterward, a privileged session was established. However, legitimate administrator activity also occurred during the same period. Determine whether an account was compromised and identify the malicious source.
objective: Correlate Wazuh authentication alerts, system authentication records and Zeek network connections to identify the compromised account, attack source, successful access time and authentication technique.

questions.label: Identify the malicious authentication source IP
Identify the successful malicious login time
